name: hey
description: Run your work off one markdown ledger: checklist, MD/AI estimates, a morning briefing and an end-of-day record. Start with wassup, end with seeya.

interface.shortDescription: Run your work off one markdown ledger.
interface.longDescription: One markdown file in your project holds the checklist, the estimates, the work log and the notes. Scripts do every calculation - box counts, effort totals, daily output, burndown, estimate variance - so no number is ever written by eye. Start the day with wassup for yesterday's context and today's load, end it with seeya to log what happened. Nothing leaves the machine.
capabilities: Turns a spec into a checklist with man-day and AI-day estimates
Prints a morning briefing and an end-of-day record from the ledger
Tracks closed work, code volume and token usage against your own past records
Reports burndown, carry-over and estimate variance for a weekly review
interface.defaultPrompt: What should I work on today?
